set.body: Reduce interaction latency where the live receipt shows the actual bottleneck. Evaluate off-main-thread/worker sampling, cancellation/coalescing of obsolete scroll requests, and bounded adjacent-slice prefetch. Preserve synchronous deterministic compilation as the reference contract. Accept only changes with structural receipts, differential correctness tests, and a new same-browser benchmark receipt showing a material scroll benefit.
set.title: Viewer pipeline 5: asynchronous sampling latency tranche
